ai_summary: Aarti Industries Limited delivered robust financial results for Q2 FY27, achieving record quarterly revenue (₹3,887 crore, +73% YoY) and EBITDA (₹418 crore, +44% YoY), driven by over 30% volume growth and strong export demand. The company is strategically positioned for sustained future growth with the commissioning of Zone IV and a new 10-year manufacturing agreement valued at ₹1,500 crore. While high raw material costs led to suppressed EBITDA margins, these were effectively passed through to customers, protecting absolute EBITDA and indicating a strong outlook leveraging favorable global trade dynamics.
